title: Bridging Bench and Bytes: Syringic Acid and Nifuroxazide Reduce Stress-Induced Anxiety via NF-kappaB/NLRP3 Modulation and Docking Validation.
authors: Bhatia, Tejas; Pahelkar, Akshata; Doshi, Gaurav; Godad, Angel
one_liner_zh: 该文研究丁香酸和硝呋齐特通过NF-kB/NLRP3通路缓解焦虑，分子对接仅针对小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Anxiety disorders are among the most prevalent neuropsychiatric conditions, with oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, and serotonergic dysfunction contributing to their pathogenesis. Novel therapeutic approaches targeting these mechanisms are urgently required. The present study evaluated the anxiolytic potential of syringic acid (SA), nifuroxazide (NFU), and their combinations in a restraint stress-induced mouse model of anxiety. Behavioral parameters were assessed using the elevated plus maze, light-dark box, open field, and marble burying tests. Biochemical markers of oxidative stress, including superoxide dismutase (SOD) and glutathione (GSH), were quantified, along with pro-inflammatory mediators NLRP3, NF-kappaB, TNF-alpha, and IL-1beta. Serotonin levels were measured by ELISA. Molecular docking studies were performed to explore the binding interactions of SA with NLRP3 and NFU with NF-kappaB. Restraint stress induced significant anxiety-like behavior, oxidative imbalance, and upregulation of inflammatory markers, accompanied by reduced serotonin levels. SA treatment significantly improved behavioral performance, restored SOD and GSH activity, and reduced NLRP3, NF-kappaB, TNF-alpha, and IL-1beta levels. NFU alone showed minimal behavioral and biochemical benefits but, in combination with SA (particularly at full dose), produced marked anxiolytic effects, attenuated inflammation, and partially restored serotonin concentrations. Docking studies supported these findings, revealing stable interactions of SA with NLRP3 and NFU with NF-kappaB. Syringic acid demonstrates potent anxiolytic activity, mediated through antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and serotonergic modulation. Its combination with nifuroxazide further enhances these effects, highlighting a promising therapeutic strategy against anxiety disorders.
abstract_zh: 焦虑症是最普遍的精神神经疾病之一，氧化应激、神经炎症和血清素能功能障碍参与其发病机制。针对这些机制的新型治疗方法亟需开发。本研究在束缚应激诱导的小鼠焦虑模型中评估了丁香酸（SA）、硝呋齐特（NFU）及其组合的抗焦虑潜力。采用高架十字迷宫、明暗箱、旷场和埋珠实验评估行为学参数。定量检测氧化应激生化标志物，包括超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和谷胱甘肽（GSH），以及促炎介质NLRP3、NF-kappaB、TNF-alpha和IL-1beta。通过ELISA测定血清素水平。进行分子对接研究以探索SA与NLRP3及NFU与NF-kappaB的结合相互作用。束缚应激诱导了显著的焦虑样行为、氧化失衡和炎症标志物上调，并伴随血清素水平降低。SA治疗显著改善行为表现，恢复SOD和GSH活性，并降低NLRP3、NF-kappaB、TNF-alpha和IL-1beta水平。NFU单独使用仅表现出轻微的行为学和生化获益，但与SA联用（尤其是全剂量）时，产生显著抗焦虑效果，减轻炎症，并部分恢复血清素浓度。对接研究支持这些发现，揭示了SA与NLRP3及NFU与NF-kappaB的稳定相互作用。丁香酸通过抗氧化、抗炎和血清素能调节表现出强效抗焦虑活性。其与硝呋齐特联用进一步增强这些效果，凸显了针对焦虑症的一种有前景的治疗策略。
